hook: China just built an AI lifebuoy that flies to you when you're drowning.
checked: CGTN: AI-powered flying lifebuoy debuts in Hangzhou rescue drill - https://news.cgtn.com/news/2026-08-17/AI-powered-flying-lifebuoy-debuts-in-Hangzhou-rescue-drill-1PGGsoqvapy/p.html
Global Times: China's AI-powered 'flying lifebuoy' joins water rescue toolkit - https://www.globaltimes.cn/page/202608/1368729.shtml

captions.instagram:
Watch this drone fly straight to a drowning swimmer, no pilot, no boat 😳

This AI-powered flying lifebuoy was tested in a real rescue drill in Hangzhou, China. It reaches the swimmer, drops buoyancy to hold onto, then flies itself back to shore once they're safe.

Open water rescue is a race against minutes — this automates the hardest one.

Would you trust a drone to reach you before a lifeguard could? 👇
